'''Rubén Castillo Anchapuri''' (March 18, 1931 – February 17, 2009) was a Peruvian theologist and biologist. After the formation of the Universidad Unión Incaica in January 1984, Anchapuri was made the head of the University Council established in May of that year.<ref>{{cite web |last=Espinoza |first=Junior Israel Pacheco |date=April 2018 |title=Evaluación de la eficiencia de programas de educación ambiental y segregación en la fuente, en el Incremento de conocimientos, actitudes y prácticas ambientales en la Universidad Peruana Unión |url=https://pdf.core.ac.uk/corefilesystem/pdf/13735/478792912.pdf?se=2026-11-01T00%3A46%3A08Z&sp=r&sv=2026-10-06&sr=b&rscd=inline%3B%20filename%3D%22478792912.pdf%22&rsct=application/pdf&sig=7It67lCdfNM0a3mZ3EjE9eEBsvE8mB1/kdp%2BQ7C1KQ0%3D |website=core.ac.uk |publisher=[[COnnecting REpositories]] |access-date=October 31, 2026}}</ref>
